regression: Host and terrain worker launch from Unicode installation/data paths under an ASCII locale.
cause: Startup RUBYLIB entries can carry US-ASCII tags on UTF-8 filesystem bytes; joining them with runtime-added UTF-8 paths raised Encoding::CompatibilityError.
fix: Join filesystem bytes without transcoding when constructing each child interpreter load path.
fixture_correction: Create Unicode subdirectories explicitly because Ruby mktmpdir strips non-ASCII prefixes; isolate package-style launches from Bundler startup injection.
before_fix: Both worker tests reproduced the incompatible encoding failure.
after_fix: Final complete suites pass on Ruby 3.4.7 and 4.0.7; relocated package fresh/resumed launches pass under unset and C locales.
